name: forma-machine-operability
principle: Every human-operable action has a deterministic semantically discoverable machine-operable path to the same authoritative application state.

authority.forma: semantic markup, accessible naming, public structure and presentation-state hooks
authority.applicationOrLimen: behavior beyond native HTML and application state synchronization
authority.ordoOrDomain: legality, capabilities, obligations, permissions and consequential transitions

requirementIdentity.placement: on the element of the component's kind (the input, textarea, select, button, link, display or region itself), never on a wrapper, label or unrelated element

components.text-input: input of type text, search, email, url, tel, number, date, datetime-local or password
components.display: dd, dt, time, output, p, span, strong, data, li, td, h1-h4
components.region: section, form, fieldset, main, nav, aside, dialog

requirementIdentity.scope: one element per ID per active scope; repeated controls carry distinct data-requirement-instance keys
